question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Spurious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Authentic)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Spurious"** means something that is false or fake; not being what it purports to be. (झूठा / नकली)

 
 
• **Example:** The document was spurious and could not be used as evidence in court.
 
 
 
• **"Authentic"** refers to something genuine, real, and true to its origin or nature. (प्रामाणिक)
 
 
• **Example:** The painting was verified as an authentic work of Vincent van Gogh.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Spurious'** is **'Authentic'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Authentic)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fake** (नकली): Something that is not real or genuine; an imitation.

 
 
• **Example:** The jewelry was fake and made of cheap materials.
 
 
 
• **Bogus** (नकली): Something that is counterfeit or not authentic.
 
 
• **Example:** The company was accused of issuing bogus invoices to customers.
 
 
 
• **Counterfeit** (जाली): Made in exact imitation of something valuable with the intent to deceive.
 
 
• **Example:** The bank detected counterfeit currency during a routine check.
